title: Declared on/off compressor (compressor_modulation=on_off) is planned as modulating; switch+setpoint loses its clamp
claim: With compressor_modulation=on_off, thermal_model.declared_modulation returns True (modulating), so the plan one real cycle publishes is never projected onto {0} U [p_min, p_max]: 0 of 10 grid cells clamp (10 of 10 under the documented mapping), 8-9 of 10 publish steps in (0, p_min), and on an unmetered switch+setpoint plant the declaration switches the install probe's clamp off (10/10 -> 0/10).
mechanism: declared_modulation maps COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF to True, the value its docstring and the modulating branch reserve for 'modulating'; duty_cycle_realizable then short-circuits to True, levels_clamped to False, and OptimizationConfig.from_mapping solves with clamp_planned_levels=False; probe_install.on_off (declared_modulation(cfg) is False) is also never set.

evidence.unit: grid cells (of 10) whose on_off-declared plan is clamped onto {0} U [p_min,p_max] (RESULT on_off_clamped_cells); switch_setpoint_on_off_clamped_cells=0 vs switch_setpoint_absent_clamped_cells=10
evidence.machine: box B6, Linux x86_64, python 3.14.7, numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1
evidence.contention_note: two other compute seats on B6 plus this seat's own background runs (load1 5-13); counts are contention-immune
evidence.tolerance: exact for the clamped-cell counts; on_off_sub_min_total / on_off_cells_failing depend on the hour the harness starts (prices are laid from dt_util.now, unfrozen): observed 132/8 and 92/9 on two runs, always 0/0 under the perturbation

perturbation.change: --perturb doc-modulation: mock.patch.object(thermal_model, 'declared_modulation', the docstring's map, on_off -> False); one-line production equivalent: 'False if mode == const.COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF' in declared_modulation
perturbation.observed_value: on_off_clamped_cells 0 -> 10; switch_setpoint_on_off_clamped_cells 0 -> 10; on_off_sub_min_total 132 -> 0; on_off_cells_failing 8 -> 0; surfaces.py fail_count 1 -> 0

metric_definition: Per price x weather cell, plan steps whose total electrical level (space+DHW) lies in (0, p_min) in the plan one real cycle publishes for a plant declaring compressor_modulation=on_off.
phenomenon_property: A compressor mode the user declares (on_off / modulating) is the mode the plan obeys on every write surface: on_off always projects planned levels onto {0} U [p_min, p_max], and no declaration makes the plan less constrained than the undeclared probe.

null_control.value: modulation.py: modulating and absent arms 92 sub-min steps / 0 clamped (legitimate for a modulating compressor); switch_setpoint_absent 0 sub-min / 10 clamped (the probe's own clamp). surfaces.py --reference (coord_all_features, fully mapped, M5): the undeclared auto and the modulating cells pass; modulation:on_off fails there as well (1 sub-min step, clamp off), so the defect is the on_off axis value on any plant -- the reference plant itself, undeclared, passes.
null_control.note: Not a cost claim; --flat still shows on_off 35 sub-min steps, switch_setpoint_on_off 35 vs switch_setpoint_absent 0.

reproduction_steps: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 -c "import sys;sys.path[:0]=['tests','custom_components'];from heatpump_optimizer import thermal_model as t;print(t.declared_modulation({'compressor_modulation':'on_off'}))"  -> True (docstring: False)
run modulation.py; read RESULT on_off_clamped_cells=0 and switch_setpoint_on_off_clamped_cells=0 vs switch_setpoint_absent_clamped_cells=10
run modulation.py --perturb doc-modulation; every on_off count goes to 0 / clamped 10
surfaces.py (M3, 32 cells): fail_count=1 (modulation:on_off); --perturb doc-modulation -> fail_count=0; --entry (real async_setup_entry) reproduces it
proposed_fix_scope: thermal_model.declared_modulation: map COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF to False; tests/features.py's #3289 block already states that expectation
